facts.text: Date: August 26, 2026 — rock–ice collapse near Nepal–China border
facts.head: Event

facts.text: Toll: 579 deaths in Nepal; ~2,000 missing; 93,000+ need assistance; Kailash Mansarovar pilgrims missing
facts.head: Event

facts.text: Initially read as a 4.4-magnitude quake; USGS said signal was from the collapse; energy equal to ~magnitude 5.2
facts.head: Event

facts.text: Material plunged ~1 km; ⚠ not a conventional GLOF — a rock–ice collapse-triggered debris flood
facts.head: Event

facts.text: Nepal: ~475 MW hydropower capacity lost
facts.head: Event

facts.text: China: Gyirong Port (Tibet) buried — upgraded at $175.8 million
facts.head: Event

facts.text: India: Rivers Gandak, Kosi, Ganga; Bihar and UP alert; Valmikinagar Barrage watched; Maharajganj, Kushinagar; India sent 47.5 tonnes of relief
facts.head: Event

facts.text: National GLOF Risk Mitigation Programme: ₹150 crore — Arunachal Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh, Sikkim, Uttarakhand

facts.head: India's Himalayan hazard measures

facts.text: Ladakh launched restoration of shrinking Tso Kar ("White Lake") on Rupshu Plateau
facts.head: News

facts.text: Habitat of Black-necked Crane; Tso Kar Wetland Complex — Ramsar 2020 (Tso Kar + Startsapuk Tso)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Tso Kar — high-altitude saline lake–wetland complex in southeastern Ladakh
facts.head: News

facts.text: UNGA resolution promoting equal-area maps — moved by Togo under "Correct the Map"; 164 of 193 in favour incl. India; ⚠ USA voted against
facts.head: News

facts.text: Mercator projection (Gerardus Mercator, 1569) enlarges high latitudes — ⚠ Africa ~14 times larger than Greenland
facts.head: News

facts.text: Mercator useful for navigation — constant compass bearings are straight lines; no flat map preserves area, shape, distance and direction together
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Change is only visual — borders and sovereignty unaffected
facts.head: News

facts.text: "Child of Krakatau" — rose from caldera of the 1883 Krakatau eruption; Indonesia on Pacific Ring of Fire
facts.head: News

facts.text: Sunda Strait links Java Sea with Indian Ocean; 1883 eruption caused massive tsunamis
facts.head: News
